summary:
I took the 14 acceptance criteria one at a time and every one is met by something I ran on this PC. Two preconditions owed to validate, O-041 and O-042, can only be settled by a person changing Explorer's settings, so both are graded cannot-tell. Explorer's actual selection behaviour at Hidden=2 was not re-measured.

**Core tests**
- Full suite: 689 of 692 passed. The 3 failures are the last-access tests (HeldOpenTreeTests ×2, LastAccessTests ×1). Build-check saw the same three fail on the tree before this slice.
- The ShellReveal, ArchitectureRules, ExplorerSettingsWriteRule and RuleCopiesAgree tests: 199 of 199 passed. Every test that pins a criterion is among them by name.

**Shipped exe, under this PC's real settings**
- The published exe is newer than the sources. It contains the new refusal text and not the old hidden-item note.
- R-003 passed:
  - (a) Windows' defaults injected (0|0): all five targets refused with the exact texts.
  - (b) A malformed injected value stopped the app before Main, with exit 0xE0434352.
  - (c) The real C:\pagefile.sys, from a C:\ scan stopped after the root listing, was refused naming both settings.
  - (d) Under the real settings in force (1,0), the Hidden+System temp file and folder were refused naming only 'Hide protected operating system files'.
  - No Explorer window opened in any step.
- B-007, S-001 and S-006 passed. At 560x644 the status line is one line of 15.96 px, and the first 141 of 323 characters show, including the 'Nothing was opened: Explorer hides' lead.

**Other required runs**
- WindowMutants -Mutant All, which Q-114 requires: 12 of 12 passed. In NoExplorerViewMember, R-003 failed only on the armed check, with reason=member.
- Fitness: all 85 rules hold.
- rules-parity: AGREE (18 facts, 22 twinned entries, 48 patterns).
- The full rules harness, which Q-027 requires: 117 rows, all 117 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits, exit 0.

**Machine state**
- HKCU Hidden=1 and ShowSuperHidden=0 at every step.
- 0 Explorer windows at every step.
- I cleaned up my temp folders. The mutant scratch copies were gone afterwards.

**Two failures, both caused by TEMP, not by this slice**
- Under the engine's TEMP (C:\WINDOWS\TEMP), B-008 fails its check that the outcome's title and detail run past 400 characters: they come to 384. Its status-line checks passed. That check and B-008's root were last changed in SL-040, and the root's length follows TEMP's.
- Under the same TEMP, RuleCases C-006/007/008/009/012/014 stop on 'Access is denied'. This user cannot list C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, and Remove-Item failed the same way on my own folder there.
- Both passed in full with TEMP pointed at a folder I made that this user can list and that is longer than the default: B-008 reached 407 characters, and RuleCases printed 'All checks held'.
- Both are filed as extra.

**Code read, no defect found**
- Walk reads the target's own attributes before the open.
- It asks for the view only for a Hidden target that is not a volume root.
- It refuses with nothing opened, and frees the ID list once on every path.
- The test override can only hide: the view used is the real one ANDed with the override.
- SHGetSetSettings is only ever called to read.
- The SDK 10.0.26100 header ShlObj_core.h agrees with the decode: fShowSuperHidden is bit 15, and SSF_SHOWSUPERHIDDEN is 0x00040000.

I grade contact as code. The strongest thing I touched was the shipped exe under the PC's live shell settings. It never let Explorer open anything, by design, so Explorer's behaviour itself was not observed.

criteria.criterion: 1. Reveal an item that is not Hidden: a plain or System-only file or folder
criteria.how: Walk_ItemNotHidden_PlainOrSystemOnly_OpensWithoutReadingTheView passed for all 16 rows in the focused run (199/199) and in the full suite. Each row is Exact, with 0 view reads, open called once, free called once and View null.

criteria.criterion: 2. Reveal a non-hidden item with a +H or +H+S folder above it
criteria.how: Walk_PlainItemUnderHiddenOrHiddenSystemFolder_OpensWithoutReadingTheView passed for all 6 rows at injected 0|0, with the item at depth 1 and 3: Exact with 0 view reads. The rule that only the item's own attributes decide rests on spike verdicts I did not re-run: Windows Sandbox (build 26100) 18/18 for each class, and the run-2285 control under +H AppData.

criteria.criterion: 3. Reveal a Hidden-only item while hidden files are not shown, including a +H file in a +H folder and a path over 260 characters
criteria.how: Walk_HiddenOnlyWhileHiddenFilesAreNotShown_RefusesWithoutOpening passed for all 7 rows: Failed / HiddenByExplorerSettings, HiddenBy=HiddenFiles, HResult 0, open never called, free called once. Through the shipped exe, R-003(a) refused h_file.dat and h_dir under injected 0|0 with the exact text and opened no window.

criteria.criterion: 4. Reveal a Hidden item when every setting that would hide it is set to show: H-only at (1,x), H+S at (1,1)
criteria.how: Walk_HiddenItemWhoseEverySettingShowsIt_Lands passed for all 7 rows: Exact, 1 view read, open called once. Select-String 'only highlights it if' in MainWindow.xaml.cs returns 0 matches. A scan of the published exe at both byte alignments finds the new refusal text and not the old note. The landing through the exe with an empty status line (R-001 step 5) opens Explorer and was left to a person.

criteria.criterion: 5. Reveal a Hidden+System item while protected files are hidden, at the owner's (1,0) and at Windows defaults (0,0)
criteria.how: Walk_HiddenSystemWhileASettingHidesIt_RefusesNamingEachSettingThatHides passed for all 6 rows: ProtectedFiles at 1|0, both settings at 0|0, HiddenFiles at 0|1, open never called. R-003(a) and (c) refused naming both settings under injected 0|0. R-003(d) refused hs_file.sys and hs_dir naming only ProtectedFiles under this PC's real (1,0), with no injection.

criteria.criterion: 6. Reveal an item the user cannot open: a deny-all +H+S temp folder, the real C:\System Volume Information, and the paging file
criteria.how: Walk_HiddenSystemFolderTheUserCannotOpen_IsRefusedNotTakenForVisible and Walk_RealProtectedItemsAtTheSystemRoot_AreRefusedAndNeverOpened both passed. The second uses the real parse on an STA thread over System Volume Information and every Hidden+System *.sys at C:\, and never skips. R-003(c) also refused the real pagefile.sys through the shipped exe from a real C:\ scan stopped at the root listing.

criteria.criterion: 7. Reveal a volume root (C:\), whose own attributes read Hidden+System
criteria.how: Walk_VolumeRoot_IsExemptAndReadsNoView passed: C:\ at injected 0|0 is Exact, with 0 view reads and View null.

criteria.criterion: 8. An earlier failure on a hidden target: it no longer exists, it parses as another item, or its name is unaddressable
criteria.how: Walk_EarlierFailureOnAHiddenSystemTarget_KeepsItsReasonAndReadsNoView passed for all 3 rows. Each keeps its reason (NoLongerExists, ParsedAsAnotherItem, NameUnaddressable), reads 0 views, and frees the ID list once wherever one was made.

criteria.criterion: 9. Read Explorer's view settings when the shell-state DWORD carries other bits (0x5, 0x8) or bit 15 (0x8000, 0x8001)
criteria.how: FromShellState_ReadsBitZeroAsHiddenAndBitFifteenAsProtected passed for all 8 values (0x0 through 0xFFFF7FFE). ReadExplorerView_AgreesWithTheRegistryOnThisPc passed against the live shell (HKCU 1/0). The SDK 10.0.26100 ShlObj_core.h, lines 3254-3269 and 3374, puts fShowSuperHidden at bit 15 and SSF_SHOWSUPERHIDDEN at 0x40000, matching the code. A live read of bit 15 as 1 has never happened; that is O-042.

criteria.criterion: 10. Inject a view for a test: every real × injected pair, and null
criteria.how: ExplorerViewOverride_OnlyHides_ForEveryRealViewAndMask passed: over 4×4 pairs plus null, the view used is the real one ANDed with the injected one, and no refusal becomes a landing. OverrideExplorerView_IsTheMaskRevealsAreDecidedUnder passed: set, then cleared back to the real read.

criteria.criterion: 11. The status line for each label variant: HiddenFiles only, both, ProtectedFiles only
criteria.how: R-003 passed and compares the exact text with CheckEqual. HiddenFiles only for h_file.dat and h_dir at injected 0|0. Both settings for hs_file.sys, hs_dir, the 200-character .sys and pagefile.sys at 0|0. ProtectedFiles only for hs_file.sys and hs_dir under the real (1,0). No Explorer window opened.

criteria.criterion: 12. Arming the hook's view injection when FSA_HOOK_EXPLORER_VIEW is malformed, or OverrideExplorerView cannot be found
criteria.how: R-003(b) with '2|x': the hook logged 'explorer-view refused reason=format', there was no reveal record, the driver never started, and the exit was 0xE0434352. WindowMutants -Mutant All passed 12/12. Its NoExplorerViewMember mutant made R-003 fail only on the two armed checks, with 'reason=member MissingMethodException'.

criteria.criterion: 13. The longest refusal at the minimum window size: both labels with a 200-character name at 560x644
criteria.how: B-007 passed: one status line of 15.96 px, text 1223.91 px untrimmed in 512 px, the first 141 of 323 characters shown, the refusal lead shown before the ellipsis, all lists keeping their rows. S-001 and S-006 passed. B-008's status-line checks passed under both TEMPs. Its only failure, the title-and-detail length check under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, depends on TEMP and passed at 407 characters under a longer TEMP.

criteria.criterion: 14. Reveal an item when the attribute read throws (the item is deleted between the parse and the read)
criteria.how: The design set no check here and judged it immaterial. I read the code: the catch counts the item as not hidden and Walk goes on to the open, as the design's error_cases say. The branch is exercised by Walk_TargetParses_OpensItOnceFreesItAndReportsExact and Walk_OpenFails_..., whose fake parse succeeds for C:\a\b.txt. Test-Path C:\a is False on this PC, so File.GetAttributes throws there. Both tests passed.

obligations.evidence: Code read: every reveal calls EffectiveExplorerView, which calls ReadExplorerView, which calls SHGetSetSettings afresh. The app caches nothing. Whether shell32 returns the new value in a long-running WPF process after Explorer's setting is toggled was not measured: spike shgetsetsettings-tracks-midsession-toggle is undecided, and I may not change Explorer's settings. PERSON-RUN: (1) Start artifacts\publish\FsAnalyser.App.exe on a temp folder holding a file with attrib +h +s, and reveal that file. The status line must read "Nothing was opened: Explorer hides '<name>' (Hide protected operating system files)." (2) Without closing the app, untick 'Hide protected operating system files' in File Explorer Options > View and press Apply. (3) Reveal the same row again. Explorer must open the folder with that file selected, and the status line must be empty. (4) Tick the option again, Apply, and reveal again. It must be refused again. Repeat with View > Show > Hidden items for a +h-only file.

The SDK 10.0.26100 ShlObj_core.h places fShowSuperHidden at bit 15 of SHELLSTATE's first DWORD, and SSF_SHOWSUPERHIDDEN is 0x40000; both match the code. FromShellState pins the decode for 0x8000 and 0x8001. But on this PC (ShowSuperHidden=0) and in the Sandbox the live shell has only ever returned bit 15 = 0, and I may not change the setting. PERSON-RUN: untick 'Hide protected operating system files' in File Explorer Options > View and press Apply. Then run: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ReadExplorerView_AgreesWithTheRegistryOnThisPc" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed". It must pass and print 'HKCU Hidden=1 ShowSuperHidden=1; the shell's state reads ExplorerView { ShowsHidden = True, ShowsProtected = True }'. Then tick the option again.

not_reached: What Explorer actually selects at Windows' defaults (Hidden=2, ShowSuperHidden=0). The 0-of-13 claim behind this slice was not re-measured; it needs a person to change the setting, and the exe now refuses before any open, so it cannot be re-measured through the exe (SC-159).
Whether shell32 returns a fresh view in the running app after Explorer's setting is toggled mid-session (O-041).
Bit 15 of the live shell state reading 1 when protected files are shown (O-042). Only 0 has ever been observed.
R-001 step 5 and R-002 through the exe: a Hidden-only item at this PC's (1,0) landing with the item selected and an empty status line. These open real Explorer windows and are left to a person.
The Hidden+System at (1,1) landing cell, which is predicted, not measured, and the (0,1)/(2,1) cells.

A hidden ancestor not blocking selection on this host's build 26200 at Hidden=2. It was measured only in Windows Sandbox (26100, Explorer at High integrity) and through the run-2285 control under +H AppData.
Real C:\Program Files\WindowsApps and System-only real items at Windows' defaults.
Windows 10: the SHGetSetSettings decode and Explorer's hidden filtering were not checked there (Q-197).
